en.template: Compare running watches for {race}, {routine}, {phone}, {budget}, {routes} and {prefs}. Separate published specs from hands-on reviewers' findings, check exact offers and taxes, and explain which features I can skip. Research only; do not create accounts or buy anything.

phases.title: Check US prices, stock, official specs and review caveats for five candidates
phases.note: Official pages and retailers for price and availability, then hands-on reviews
phases.judgment: It did not let old review complaints stand as today’s facts: early problems with the Suunto Run’s heart-rate reading were treated as launch-era, since later software updates changed it and no one had retested it. It also dropped the Polar Pacer because the official US price was above the budget, and flagged that Suunto’s $199 coupon had not been tested at checkout.

phases.title: Write the practical shortlist and a dated source list
phases.note: Comparison table, two recommended watches, what a beginner can skip paying for
phases.judgment: It kept two different things apart that listings blur: how many satellite systems a watch uses is not the same as dual-frequency GPS. It also labelled the choice of two watches as editorial judgment, not measurement, and said plainly that it had not tested any watch itself.

phases.title: Check content, links and layout, then deliver both files
